answer:
ArgoCD directly accesses ObjectMeta.Labels map for application labeling. Cert-manager constructs ObjectMeta with Labels map literals for ACME challenge resources. External-secrets CRD types use Labels for store/secret selection. Prometheus reads ObjectMeta.Labels to construct __meta_kubernetes_*_label_* target labels. Loki Operator constructs resources with ObjectMeta.Labels for all components. OpenTelemetry Operator CRD types use Labels for collector and instrumentation resources.

## Affected Files

| Repo | File | Why |
|------|------|-----|
| argo-cd | `controller/appcontroller.go` | Directly accesses ObjectMeta.Labels map for application resource labeling |
| argo-cd | `util/settings/settings.go` | Accesses Labels map for settings resources |
| cert-manager | `pkg/issuer/acme/http/pod.go` | Constructs ObjectMeta with Labels map literals for ACME challenge pods |
| cert-manager | `pkg/issuer/acme/http/service.go` | Constructs Labels map literals for ACME challenge services |
| cert-manager | `pkg/issuer/acme/http/ingress.go` | Constructs Labels map literals for ACME challenge ingresses |
| external-secrets | `pkg/controllers/externalsecret/externalsecret_controller.go` | Directly accesses .Labels[esv1.LabelManaged], assigns Labels = make(map[string]string), sets Labels[esv1.LabelOwner] |
| external-secrets | `pkg/controllers/webhookconfig/webhookconfig.go` | Accesses cfg.Labels[constants.WellKnownLabelKey] to check webhook labels and secret.Labels for CA cert management |
| external-secrets | `apis/externalsecrets/v1/clusterexternalsecret_types.go` | ExternalSecretMetadata struct defines Labels map[string]string field |
| prometheus | `discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go` | Reads ObjectMeta.Labels for target label construction |
| prometheus | `discovery/kubernetes/pod.go` | Reads pod ObjectMeta.Labels for __meta_kubernetes_pod_label_* labels |
| prometheus | `discovery/kubernetes/node.go` | Reads node ObjectMeta.Labels for __meta_kubernetes_node_label_* labels |
| prometheus | `discovery/kubernetes/service.go` | Reads service ObjectMeta.Labels for target labels |
| loki | `operator/internal/manifests/config.go` | Loki Operator constructs resources with ObjectMeta.Labels |
| loki | `operator/internal/manifests/distributor.go` | Distributor component Labels |
| loki | `operator/internal/manifests/compactor.go` | Compactor component Labels |
| loki | `operator/internal/manifests/gateway.go` | Gateway component Labels |
| opentelemetry-operator | `apis/v1beta1/opentelemetrycollector_types.go` | CRD types embed ObjectMeta and use Labels for collectors |
| opentelemetry-operator | `internal/manifests/collector/service.go` | Directly accesses h.Labels[headlessLabel] and h.Labels[serviceTypeLabel] to set headless service labels |
| opentelemetry-operator | `pkg/sidecar/pod.go` | Sets pod.Labels = map[string]string{} and pod.Labels[injectedLabel] for sidecar injection tracking |
| opentelemetry-operator | `internal/manifests/mutate.go` | Manifest mutation assigns existing.Labels = desired.Labels for multiple resource types |
